'''Ranats''' were a [[species]] of [[Sentience|sentients]] [[rodent]]-like [[humanoid]]s. Ranats had long tails, sharp [[Tooth|teeth]] including large incisors, elongated [[Hair|whiskers]], and a keen sense of smell. Ranats were found throughout [[the galaxy]] and worked in various occupations including as [[bounty hunter]]s and [[soldier]]s.

==Biology and appearance==
The [[species]] of [[Sentience|sentients]] [[rodent]]-like [[humanoid]]s possessed long tails, long [[Tooth|incisors]] which protruded from their lower jaw, elongated facial [[Hair|whiskers]],<ref name="EG" /> and two [[Color|brown]] [[ear]]s on the sides of their heads.<ref name="Objets" /> Their [[eye]]s could perceive the [[infrared]] spectrum and their [[Tooth|teeth]] were strong enough to chew through [[duracrete]] plate. Ranats also had a sharp sense of smell.<ref name="On the Front Lines" />

==Ranats in the galaxy==
Ranats often encountered [[Xenophobia|prejudice]] in [[the galaxy]], even during the [[New Republic Era|time]] of the [[New Republic]].<ref name="On the Front Lines" />

In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="EG Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Ezra's Gamble]]'' to [[5 BBY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified Ranat bounty hunter|Ranat bounty hunter]] and his [[Unidentified Nimbanel bounty hunter|Nimbanel colleague]] attempted to collect a [[bounty]] on the [[Trandoshan]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] of [[Lothal]], which had been issued by the corrupt [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Lieutenant]] [[Jenkes]]. However, Bossk overpowered them and knocked them unconscious.<ref name="EG" /> A few years before the [[Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="ABOCDate">"[[Always Bet on Chop]]" takes place during the events of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' and includes [[Rex]], placing it after the events of "[[The Lost Commanders]]." ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "The Lost Commanders" to [[4 BBY]] and the ending of ''Star Wars Rebels'' to [[1 BBY]], placing "Always Bet on Chop" between these [[Standard year|years]].</ref> three Ranat were seen in the audience of a [[Droid-fighting|droid-fighting]] [[Unidentified gladiatorial arena|arena]]. Later, another Ranat, [[Nevar Yalnal]], was spotted at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the planet [[Tatooine]] during [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s fateful encounter with the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee]] companion [[Chewbacca]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> 

During the [[Battle of Jakku]], the Ranat [[New Republic soldier|soldier]] [[Musmuris Reetgeet]] was part of a predominantly [[human]] boarding party that captured the [[Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Glaciate]]''. Reetgeet personally disabled the [[cruiser]]'s [[reactor]] governor.<ref name="On the Front Lines" /> In [[3 ABY]]<ref name="BH2Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Bounty Hunters 2|''Bounty Hunters'' 2]] to [[3 ABY]].</ref> a Ranat<ref name="Script">{{Twitter|ethanjsacks|status/1820581510430495016|[[Ethan Sacks]]|quote=@paolovillanelli @Lew_Re I found the script! It's a Ranat!|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/HHjPZ}}</ref> Bartender restrained a [[Unidentified thief (Phelar Port)|thief]] on the run from [[Galactic Empire|the Empire]].<ref name="Bounty Hunters 2">[[Bounty Hunters 2|''Bounty Hunters'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ranats first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] in [[1977]] as a background costumed character.<ref name="CRC 5">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> The alien head prop was crafted by Stuart Freeborn, using rigid foam covered with synthetic hair. The head opened into two sections to allow the performer to wear it, and once closed, it remained securely in place through magnets embedded within the foam structure of the skull.<ref name="Objets" />

The Ranats also appeared in the non-canon [[2017]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures]]'' episode "[[Return to the Wheel]]." In the episode, a group of Ranats attack the [[B1-series battle droid]] [[R0-GR/LEGO|Roger]] after he stops one of their group from stealing a [[datapad]] during a [[Mission to obtain an energy matrix activator|mission]] to obtain an [[energy matrix activator]].<ref name="RttW">{{FreemakerAdventures|Return to the Wheel}}</ref>
